verdict.rationale: Skills are documented as plain directories containing a SKILL.md plus optional scripts/references that can be checked into a repo and scanned from `.agents/skills` (docs-13, docs-17, docs-9), meaning an engineering lead can read the files in version control before and after installation. However, there is no documented feature for previewing or listing a skill/plugin's contents specifically before installing via `/plugins` or `$skill-installer` (docs-6, docs-8, docs-25), and community commentary highlights skepticism about verifying skill instructions vs MCP tools (comm-1, comm-6), underscoring the lack of a formal review workflow. Missing for 10: an explicit pre-install manifest/content listing UI, a documented post-install audit/read command, and confirmation that marketplace entries expose full file trees before install.
